matrix.cell_table: Static mult-cell table built by stable cell-key sorting. This tests the production cell-list helper against O(N^2), not RunCellDivide or dynamic sorting.

constant p and nonzero constant Ace

matrix.periodic: Exactly two manually constructed x images with duplicate native IDs and copied J/p. Images are interspersed with natives by the cell table. Actual tracking must repair poisoned C; actual pressure helper must repair NaN Ace/theta and then copy the assigned native rate. At least one image-neighbor contribution is required. No periodic-compatible affine solution or actual RunPeriodic lifecycle is claimed.

predeclared_gates.actual_vs_O2_rate_pa_s: Each finite float actual rate: abs(actual-double_reference) <= 32*FLT_EPSILON*max(1,abs(reference))+1e-6. Reference uses the same stored float p/Ace, double position/J/C/theta and actual Wendland API, but independently searches every particle without cell-list calls.
predeclared_gates.k0: Every result exactly equals float(-Kw/n*theta), with nonzero input p and Ace; sentinel must be overwritten, proving complete compression replacement once.
predeclared_gates.affine_null_pa_s: Only nonperiodic affine-equilibrium and constant-flux cases: abs(rate)<=.001 Pa/s; declared roundoff floor, not a measured-after-run threshold.
predeclared_gates.ct_source_suppression: For regular/jitter 2D/3D, k=0 and positive k, the actual old ct must leave all rate sentinels unchanged while observed abs(theta)>.01 proves a nonempty compression path.
predeclared_gates.periodic_repair: Two nonempty images; owner matches via native ID; all C bytes after actual tracking and Ace/theta/rate bytes after actual helper must equal the native owner. Actual image neighbors required; no NaN may survive into assigned rate.
predeclared_gates.default_OFF_control: Fresh unchanged P2 feedback component on the new binary must exactly match all six retained accepted r2 text results (ledger/momentum/history/halves/guards/complete). Run.out diagnostic source-line offsets are not compared. No old solver/control is rerun or overwritten.
predeclared_gates.execution_order: DebugCPU build+run then ReleaseCPU only if Debug passes. Build/source/runtime inputs are verified immediately before and after each run. Preserve every failed label.

quadratic: Per-node actual and discrete-reference rates are retained descriptively. No quadratic balance, global conservation, physical mass, or energy acceptance is inferred from implementation agreement.
integration: No pressure/position integration or physical force-tail trajectory in this fixture. Original 5Pa pressure-RMS/.005mm displacement independent half limits remain unchanged for the separately owned real integrator wave stage.
default_OFF_native: Root separately checks real production default-OFF serialized 15-array trajectories; this fixture does not replace that native regression.
scope: Private no-wall elastic CPU component only; constant k>=0, no load/drainage/HG/damping/viscosity/DDT/SPR/Shepard/AccInput. No public XML switch, GPU, formal case, server, full-cycle or physical acceptance.
